name: Skiing Course
benefit: The beneficiary will become a skiing trainer or competitor, upon completing the course.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a youth from Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be between 18 and 25 years of age. 1. The applicant will be considered on a first-come, first-served basis. > The total number of 40 beneficiaries will be selected.
